Power-Up

You access the pure form of a Majin, turning into a child-like version, but despite of the small size, you are full of uncontrollable power.

  • +2 Power Bonus
  • You deal +1d6 to all Damage Rolls
  • All Techniques may use your Charisma Modifier in replace of the original Ability Modifier
  • When you would deal damage with a Technique, you deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier (Minimum 1)
  • You gain the Berserk Condition.

Gained at Level 10
